title: Residential Electricity Supply Sign-Up Credit Amount
content:
**Amount.** The sign-up credit amount on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is the sign-up credit of the plan in force, rounded half up to the cent. The plan's sign-up credit is the figure the sign-up and online enrollment credit schedule states for the plan recorded on the agreement.

**Assembly and rounding.** A multiplier acts on the plan sign-up credit; flat bonuses are added to that product; the total is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end, and posted as a negative amount.

## Illustrations (hypothetical agreements)

| Plan in force | Plan sign-up credit on the schedule | Sign-up credit |
|---|---|---|
| a plan whose schedule figure is 75.00 USD | 75.00 | 75.00 USD, posted as minus 75.00 USD |
| a plan whose schedule figure is 100.00 USD | 100.00 | 100.00 USD, posted as minus 100.00 USD |

**Rounding at the end (hypothetical totals).** A total of 93.7549 USD posts as 93.75 USD; a total of 93.755 USD posts as 93.76 USD.
